title: Definability of Functional Properties in the Basic Modal-Temporal Language over Ordered Frames
summary: We study the expressive power of the simplest modal-temporal language, obtained by adding Prior's temporal operators \(G\) and \(H\) to the basic modal language with \(\Box\). This language is the standard bimodal combination of modal and tense logic; under its functional interpretation it is denoted \(L_{T\times W}\). To analyse its definability across five order types, we consider two semantic readings of the temporal operators: the standard reading (\(G,H\)), which includes the current instant, and the strict reading (\(G^{\ast},H^{\ast}\)), which always excludes it.
